name: CircuitInventoryExplorer
tagline: Every circuit, port and bearer – and who goes down when one fails.
description: A complete telecom circuit inventory app for Power Apps and Power Pages: circuit register with A/Z ends, sites and ports with conflict detection, a recursive dependency tree with outage impact analysis (circuits, customers, revenue), bearer capacity and utilisation, and a circuit lifecycle with business rules.
features: Outage impact analysis by circuit, device or site
Dependency tree of bearers and services
Lifecycle rules with reasons, undo and bulk changes
Contracts ending and off-net carrier tails
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control CircuitInventoryExplorerPortal)
